rejected_inferences.reason: Lease webhook dispatch is exercised through a monkeypatched HTTP sender, not through a REST route in the checked inventory; it is not mapped as provider-operations REST coverage.
serve_model ready-replay service call is not an HTTP invocation; it supports service behavior only and is not treated as POST /v1/serve execution evidence.
The subtype records route calls and returns deterministic models; it deliberately performs no provider egress and cannot prove live availability, health, scheduling, billing, or durable persistence.
respx upstream responses prove relay/status/SSE handling only; they do not prove a deployed pod, provider inference, external model availability, or actual cost.
Fake ProductionRoutingService and deterministic workload models prove route serialization and delegation only; they do not prove planner persistence, worker execution, or provider billing.
